data.q: What is the hotel limit per night?
data.reply: Lodging (LODGE): per-item limit ₹6,000.00; no daily limit. Spending over a limit is flagged for the approver, not blocked.
data.source: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy: Lodging limits (http://localhost:3000/settings/policy, checked 2026-11-26)
searched: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy

data.q: Do I need a GSTIN on a ₹2,500 bill?
data.reply: The supplier's GSTIN is required for any expense above ₹2,000.00. A missing or invalid GSTIN is flagged for the approver.
data.source: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy: Supplier GSTIN (http://localhost:3000/settings/policy, checked 2026-11-26)
searched: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy

data.q: When do I need to attach a receipt?
data.reply: A receipt image is required for any expense above ₹500.00. A claim missing a required receipt is flagged when it is submitted.
data.source: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy: Receipts (http://localhost:3000/settings/policy, checked 2026-11-26)
searched: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy

data.q: Can I claim a cab on Sunday?
data.reply: Expenses dated on a Saturday or Sunday are allowed but flagged for the approver to check.
data.source: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy: Weekend spend (http://localhost:3000/settings/policy, checked 2026-11-26)
searched: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy

data.q: What must a GST tax invoice show about the supplier?
data.reply: A tax invoice issued by a registered person must show the name, address and GSTIN of the supplier, a consecutive serial number unique for the financial year (letters, numerals, hyphen or slash), and the date the invoice was issued.
data.source: CGST Invoice Rules: Tax invoice: Supplier details, serial number and date (https://cbic-gst.gov.in/gst-invoice-rules.html, checked 2026-11-26)
searched: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy
terms: gst, tax, invoice, show, supplier, gstin
